items.title: Add earlier main-sync readiness reporting
items.context: Expose branch-behind-main readiness before late DONE closure through an existing read-only lifecycle/session surface that is visible before REVIEW or at REVIEW entry. The signal must be advisory/non-blocking, include the behind-main count when available, point to the existing done_prepare/main-sync path, and must not perform a merge by itself. A DONE-only branch-synced-main row is not sufficient for this item.
items.userSees: Before REVIEW or late TEST, Lattice tells the user when the story branch is behind main, that the signal is advisory/read-only, and what command should refresh it.
excludes: Do not change story_advance DONE merge authority.
Do not add a new automatic merge path outside done_prepare/story_advance.
Do not claim Authority or production proof.
Do not satisfy this item only with the existing DONE closure branch-synced-main row.
Do not add a new hard REVIEW or TEST blocker solely because main has moved.

happy.desc: A pre-REVIEW or REVIEW-entry read-only lifecycle/session surface shows a story branch behind main with the behind count and existing done_prepare sync command before DONE closure.

edge.desc: A story branch that already contains main does not show a false behind-main warning on the same pre-REVIEW/read-only surface.

adversarial.desc: The main-sync readiness signal is advisory/read-only: it does not mutate phase, merge main, or make REVIEW/TEST entry fail solely because the branch is behind main.

items.title: Add regression coverage for the readiness signal
items.context: Add a focused smoke test that creates fixture branches and proves the pre-REVIEW/read-only main-sync readiness behavior for behind-main, synced, and no-mutation/non-blocking cases. The smoke must exercise the same surface added for CHK-001, not only the existing DONE closure branch-synced-main row.
items.userSees: lattice validate --focus=fast can prove the main-sync readiness behavior without running the whole suite.
excludes: Do not add a slow full-suite-only regression.
Do not require network or remote git access.
Do not verify only the existing DONE closure branch-synced-main behavior.
Do not accept a hard REVIEW or TEST blocker as proof of readiness.

happy.desc: The focused smoke passes and proves the pre-REVIEW/read-only main-sync readiness warning appears for a branch behind main.

edge.desc: The focused smoke proves the synced branch case has no false warning, and full validate still includes the smoke through configured validate.commands.

adversarial.desc: The smoke proves the readiness path is read-only and non-blocking by checking no merge, phase mutation, or REVIEW/TEST gate failure occurs solely from behind-main state.

items.title: Record baseline result for item 4
items.context: Add a derived baseline result artifact for baseline item 4 without modifying the immutable baseline v1 JSON.
items.userSees: The baseline comparison has a durable item 4 result entry for future tasks.
excludes: Do not collapse this with delivery-check freshness or DONE summary freshness.

happy.desc: The result artifact references baseline item 4, this story id, and the readiness behavior.

edge.desc: The immutable baseline file remains unchanged.

adversarial.desc: The result artifact states this is local lifecycle readiness coverage only, not Authority or production proof.
